title: A Survey of Parameters Associated with the Quality of Benchmarks in NLP
findings: The paper identifies that hypotheses in Natural Language Inference (NLI) datasets can contain religious stereotypes, which can act as a form of contextual bias, potentially influencing a model to favor a particular label.
